DESCRIPTION: Under-extrusion only at high speed, fine when slow
CARDS:
COMPONENT z_motor_leadscrew (Z motor and lead screw) - Moves the bed up and down; T8x8 integrated lead screw (8 mm per turn).
Failure mode: wrong setting (direction, rotation_distance, current, stall threshold) | symptom: moves wrong way, wrong distance, skipped steps or bad homing | check: compare config values with stock and calibrate
Failure mode: insufficient torque or driver fault | symptom: skipping/clicking under load or at high acceleration | check: raise current within limits; check driver temperature and wiring
COMPONENT bed_heater (Bed heater) - Heats the build plate so the first layer adheres.
Failure mode: no or weak heating (open circuit, loose cartridge, failed output) | symptom: slow or no heat-up, 'not heating at expected rate' error, cold prints | check: watch temperature graph during heat-up; measure resistance; check cartridge clamped
Failure mode: control or limit setting wrong (PID, max_temp) | symptom: temperature oscillates or printer shuts down at high temperature | check: compare PID/max_temp with stock config; re-run PID_CALIBRATE
COMPONENT mains_power_input (Mains power input (C13 power cord, IEC C14 inlet, AC wiring to the PSU)) - Brings mains AC from the wall socket through the power cord and the IEC inlet to the 24 V power supply.
Failure mode: loose plug in the inlet or wall socket, worn cord, loose AC screw terminal | symptom: whole printer switches off or restarts, often with vibration or when the cord is touched; Pi and fans go off together | check: wiggle the cord and plug at the inlet with the printer idle; check the AC terminals on the PSU are tight
Failure mode: undersized or damaged AC wire heating at the terminal | symptom: power drops after some minutes of heating; smell or discoloured terminal | check: look for discoloration at the inlet and PSU terminals; wire size >= 18 AWG
COMPONENT extruder_motor (Extruder motor and driver) - Turns the extruder gears to push a metered length of filament into the hotend.
Failure mode: wrong setting (direction, rotation_distance, current, stall threshold) | symptom: moves wrong way, wrong distance, skipped steps or bad homing | check: compare config values with stock and calibrate
Failure mode: insufficient torque or driver fault | symptom: skipping/clicking under load or at high acceleration | check: raise current within limits; check driver temperature and wiring
COMPONENT hotend_heater (Hotend heater cartridge) - Heats the hotend block so filament melts; controlled by PID from the hotend thermistor reading.
Failure mode: no or weak heating (open circuit, loose cartridge, failed output) | symptom: slow or no heat-up, 'not heating at expected rate' error, cold prints | check: watch temperature graph during heat-up; measure resistance; check cartridge clamped
Failure mode: control or limit setting wrong (PID, max_temp) | symptom: temperature oscillates or printer shuts down at high temperature | check: compare PID/max_temp with stock config; re-run PID_CALIBRATE
COMPONENT dc_power_wiring (24 V DC power wiring and crimps (PSU to controller board)) - Carries 24 V from the power supply to the controller board, which powers motors, heaters and fans.
Failure mode: bad crimp or loose screw terminal on the 24 V input | symptom: board resets or drivers drop out (TMC errors, 'Lost communication') under load or vibration; Pi may stay on | check: tug-test each crimp; measure 24 V at the board input while heaters and motors run
COMPONENT bed_thermal_fuse (Bed thermal fuse (150 °C)) - Safety fuse in series with the bed heater; it opens for good if the bed overheats.
Failure mode: fuse opened (after an overheat or a weak fuse near its rating) | symptom: bed stops heating completely; bed heater resistance reads open although the pad looks fine | check: measure across the fuse: open = blown
COMPONENT filament_runout_sensor (Filament runout sensor) - Pauses the print when filament runs out.
Failure mode: open or shorted sensor / wiring | symptom: 'ADC out of range' or absurd reading, shutdown | check: check connector and wiring; measure resistance at room temperature
Failure mode: wrong sensor configuration (type, pullup, trigger threshold) | symptom: reading offset from real value or false/no trigger | check: compare sensor_type/pullup/threshold with hardware and docs
Failure mode: intermittent contact or loose mount | symptom: spikes, drops or drifting reference between runs | check: wiggle test while watching readings; check mount rigidity
